notes.subject: ואעידה בם
notes.rationale: Hebrew 'I will testify against/in them': Hebrew reads 'in them' but most versions supply 'against'; Tok Pisin renders 'makim ol olsem witnes'.

notes.subject: הקהילו … הדברים
notes.rationale: Verse opens with assembly verb קהל and pivots on דברים 'words', framing the whole scene as speech to a gathered body.

notes.subject: to Yisrael (elders and officers)
notes.rationale: Mose addresses the leaders of the tribes directly with the plural imperative 'gather'.

notes.subject: witness formula
notes.rationale: Heaven and earth summoned as formal witnesses, the covenant-lawsuit pattern also in Deut 30:19 and 32:1.

translation: Olsem, yusaitupe long mi ⟨את⟩ olgeta ol olpela man bilong ol tribe bilong yupela, na ol ofisa bilong yupela, na bai mi toktok long ol dispela tok ⟨את⟩ ol tok hia wantaim ol tel bilong ol, na bai mi makim ol olsem witnes, ⟨את⟩ ol heven na ⟨את⟩ graun, olsem wanem ol i save long dispela.
